topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I just found out that the friend I've been talking to online for months, Alex, lives in the same city as me. It's a bit of a coincidence, and I'm thinking about reaching out to suggest we grab coffee sometime. I've got their number, but my thumbs are hovering over my phone, hesitating. I wonder if they'll still be as cool in person as they are behind the screen. There's so much we've shared, yet somehow, the idea of meeting face-to-face feels like a whole new territory. Maybe I'll start with a text, something casual. Just a 'hey, funny world, huh?' and see where it goes from there.
